_help.enableUpdateChecker: true: when a player joins, the server checks online whether a newer version of the mod exists and tells the player in chat. false: no check.
_help.checkDelayTicks: How long after joining the check starts, in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second).
_help.connectTimeoutMillis: How long to wait for the update server to accept the connection, in milliseconds.
_help.readTimeoutMillis: How long to wait for the version list to arrive, in milliseconds.
_help.notifyOnlyOncePerRun: true: the message about a new version is shown only once until the server or game restarts. false: on every join.
